digest.component_or_area: plan review gate — R1 candidate evaluation (E3 counterfactual replay)
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, clone+strip driver, pure metrics library) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 and is intentionally not landed on main
The expensive ~450-run live LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise 50-ticket×3 candidate and current fresh runs) was permanently rejected on cost grounds

Verdict-perturbation signal previously targetable only via costly replay is now accumulated at zero marginal LLM cost by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder (story d8a5, change #798, on main)
History mining is infeasible (~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 required; impact_model_version bump stranded sidecar history)
Replay driver implements recall-stripped clone (store copy with REVIEW_RESULT.json deletion), material-fingerprint drift guard, and manifest verification seams to eliminate confounds

Two-tier false-positive control structure isolates candidate effect: coarse descriptive 30-plan sample sweep plus precise FP-control pool with candidate-vs-current fresh runs using two-level median pairing and null-floor current-vs-current baseline
